metadata.description: Real Tier-1 lightweight RPN surface for cheap scalar, ternary, and stack work. This is the worker-worker tier used when latency matters more than expressiveness.
metadata.procedural_goal: keep cheap scalar and ternary work on the worker-worker tier

metadata.description: Real Tier-2 sovereign RPN surface for general vector, block, and mid-complexity work. This is the worker tier that most procedural geometry, signal, and paint programs should prefer.
metadata.procedural_goal: route general procedural math to the worker tier before escalating upward

metadata.description: Real Tier-3 advanced RPN surface for matrix, TRM-coupled, and high-complexity routines. This is the master tier and should only be used after cheaper tiers have prepared the state.
metadata.procedural_goal: reserve the master tier for high-complexity reductions and final commitments

metadata.description: Always-on runtime policy for dynamic math-core spawning, pooling, reuse, and worker-worker -> worker -> master cascade. Storage remains in the Knowledgeverse Tool galaxy while execution stays GPU/PTX-backed.
metadata.procedural_goal: make tier intent, pool reuse, and cascade policy explicit system knowledge instead of hidden runtime state

name: Dynamic Math-Core Spawn and Cascade Policy

metadata.procedural_goal: store compact ternary coefficient fields with deterministic rebuild

metadata.description: PTX-backed DCT8 block transform for image and video-style spatial frequency analysis. Use with ternary quantization for compact procedural visual storage.

metadata.description: PTX-backed gradient backdrop surface for procedural painting. Provides linear, radial, and conic backgrounds through the canonical drawing effects bridge.
metadata.procedural_goal: render painterly backdrops without bitmap assets

metadata.description: PTX-backed blur, sharpen, and invert stack for procedural canvases. These are the canonical image-editing primitives for painterly post-processing.

metadata.description: PTX-backed alpha compositing and Sobel edge extraction for procedural canvases. This turns drawings plus backdrops into a stylized, inspectable paint stack.
metadata.procedural_goal: compose procedural layers and extract ink-style structure on GPU

metadata.description: Ternary contrastive palette selection surface. Converts compact color palettes into gradient-like ternary signatures so the system can prefer positive candidates and reject negative examples without heavier color toolchains.
metadata.procedural_goal: select compact procedural palettes with ternary positive/negative pressure

metadata.description: PTX-backed ternary contrastive gradient analysis. Encodes gradient stop deltas as ternary trends, scores candidates against positives and negatives, and supports cheap gradient comparison.
metadata.procedural_goal: learn and compare gradients with positive, negative, and neutral ternary signals

metadata.description: Composes gradients from stacked ternary layers and renders them through the sovereign PTX gradient rasterizer. This is a cheap substitute for heavier continuous color machinery when ternary layers are sufficient.
metadata.procedural_goal: stack ternary deltas into editable gradients without bulk math frameworks

metadata.description: PTX-backed bounding-box and crop surface for contour-bearing grids. This is the canonical extraction step before profile or mesh preparation.
metadata.procedural_goal: extract the active contour region deterministically on GPU

name: Geometry Bounding Box and Crop Surface

metadata.description: Bridge-stage surface that turns a prepared contour profile into a deterministic centerline-following sweep mesh.
